global_defect.scope: Specified smooth genuine classical del Pezzo / smooth elliptic Rains gluing, non-torsion q, nef H with H^2>0, and the existing natural derived comparison.
global_defect.statement: The full torsionfree part F is contained in the off-boundary finite-length category Z. Natural Phi is t-exact iff (e,s) is AZ-ample iff every actual simple object of Z has positive Euler value. Numerical resonance alone is not equivalent to failure.
global_defect.key_argument: Compare restriction amplitudes, then use eventual surjectivity of g and stabilization of finite graded dimensions to identify a finite-dimensional affine module.

global_simple_tilts.statement: Off-boundary simples form a finite independent ADE root system under the geometric hypotheses. The local negative-simple procedure extends to the full heart and reaches the anticanonical heart after the initial number of negative positive roots.
global_simple_tilts.limitation: This counts the specified negative-simple factorization, not an absolute minimum over arbitrary HRS tilts; the whole comparison is also one HRS tilt.

root_existence.status: Application of an established Rains result, not a new general existence theorem.
root_existence.inputs: Rains 2107.13540v2 Section 4 pp.34-35: effectiveness of a fixed blowdown simple root with q-power restriction; Rains 1907.11301v1 Section 11 p.141, the paragraph immediately before Proposition 11.23: irreducible off-boundary sheaf for the effective simple root itself with the determinant condition.
root_existence.safeguard: Does not apply Proposition 11.23 itself with its nef/fundamental-chamber hypothesis to a simple root. Arbitrary numerical root resonance is not sufficient.

sorted_spectrum.scope: 3<=r<=8, fixed smooth plane elliptic curve with flex origin, non-torsion q, distinct positive integers N_i, and the indicated ordered Rains blowdown.
sorted_spectrum.statement: The r simple-root sheaves all exist. For sorted nu, the affine algebra has exactly r finite-dimensional simples with dimensions (nu1+nu2+nu3, nu2-nu1,...,nur-nu_(r-1)). The negative-simple procedure has inversion-number length. Only increasing order has the anticanonical heart.
sorted_spectrum.same_pointed_category: All r! orders of the same unordered point set give distinct embedded Rains hearts in the same pointed derived category, with a common anticanonical algebra.
sorted_spectrum.limitations: Not a classification of abstract abelian equivalences or all possible hearts. Original generator action matrices are not computed.
